title: 眼面部防护
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/022_眼面部防护.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/022_眼面部防护/src.py

points.K1: 眼睛最怕伤，护眼最划算
points.K2: 三类眼面防护，按用途选
points.K3: 安全眼镜防冲击，挡不住液体
points.K6: 普通眼镜不能代替护目镜
points.K7: 化学实验室不戴隐形眼镜
points.K10: 各类实验的通用防护提醒
points.S1: 眼睛进了东西，立即冲洗

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣戴着护目镜，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing safety goggles waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲眼面部防护。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰戴着近视眼镜，准备倒试剂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing ordinary prescription glasses, is about to pour a reagent.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：我戴着眼镜，够了吧？

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 侧面一滴液体飞向眼镜和脸之间的缝隙
shots.prompt_en: A side view shows a droplet flying toward the gap between ordinary glasses and the face. No real faces.
shots.narration: 液体一溅，会从镜框边的缝里进眼。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研递给他一副罩式护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands him a pair of goggles that fit over glasses.
shots.narration: 小研说：普通眼镜不算防护。

shots.section_title: 眼睛最怕伤，护眼最划算
shots.scene: 眼睛图标，周围是飞屑、液滴和强光
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon surrounded by flying chips, droplets and a bright flash. No people.
shots.narration: 眼睛最脆弱，伤了很难恢复。
overlay: 眼睛最怕伤，护眼最划算

shots.section_title: 眼睛最怕伤，护眼最划算
shots.scene: 多数眼伤被一副护目镜挡住的示意
shots.prompt_en: Most of the hazard arrows aimed at an eye icon are stopped by goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 多数眼伤，戴好防护就能避免。

shots.section_title: 眼睛最怕伤，护眼最划算
shots.scene: 钉钉子和剪焊丝时碎片弹飞
shots.prompt_en: A nail and a cut wire end fly off while hammering and snipping, toward an eye icon. No people.
shots.narration: 钉钉子、剪焊丝，碎片也会弹飞。

shots.section_title: 眼睛最怕伤，护眼最划算
shots.scene: 压力气体、焊接、危险物质三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a gas cylinder, a welding spark and a chemical bottle, each with an eye icon. No people.
shots.narration: 压力气体、焊接、化学品，都要护眼。

shots.section_title: 三类眼面防护，按用途选
shots.scene: 安全眼镜、护目镜、面屏三样并排
shots.prompt_en: Safety spectacles, sealed goggles and a face shield side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 眼面防护分三类：眼镜、护目镜、面屏。
overlay: 三类眼面防护，按用途选

shots.section_title: 三类眼面防护，按用途选
shots.scene: 三样防护分别对应碎屑、飞溅、大面积喷溅
shots.prompt_en: Each item is linked to a hazard: flying chips, liquid splash and a large spray toward the face. No people.
shots.narration: 按危害选一种，或者组合用。

shots.section_title: 三类眼面防护，按用途选
shots.scene: 强光图标旁的遮光护目镜，激光和焊接图标指向别处
shots.prompt_en: Tinted shade goggles beside a bright light icon; laser and welding icons point to separate boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 强光要遮光镜，激光焊接另有专用。

shots.section_title: 安全眼镜防冲击，挡不住液体
shots.scene: 安全眼镜挡住飞来的碎屑
shots.prompt_en: Safety spectacles with side shields stop a flying chip. No people.
shots.narration: 安全眼镜防冲击，挡得住碎屑。
overlay: 安全眼镜防冲击，挡不住液体

shots.section_title: 安全眼镜防冲击，挡不住液体
shots.scene: 液体从侧面和上方绕过安全眼镜，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Liquid splashes around safety spectacles from the side and top, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 但液体会从侧面和上方绕进来。

shots.section_title: 安全眼镜防冲击，挡不住液体
shots.scene: 安全眼镜和护目镜之间画不等号
shots.prompt_en: A not-equal sign between safety spectacles and sealed goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 安全眼镜和护目镜，不能互相代替。

shots.section_title: 有飞溅，戴防溅护目镜
shots.scene: 间接通风护目镜贴合面部，液滴被挡住
shots.prompt_en: Indirect-vent chemical splash goggles seal around the eyes and stop a droplet. No people.
shots.narration: 有飞溅，戴贴合面部的防溅护目镜。

shots.section_title: 有飞溅，戴防溅护目镜
shots.scene: 通风孔放大：直通孔打叉，带罩的间接通风孔打勾
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of vents: open direct vents with a red X, covered indirect vents with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 选间接通风的，液体进不来。

shots.section_title: 有飞溅，戴防溅护目镜
shots.scene: 倒消毒剂、配酸碱的场景
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands pour disinfectant and prepare an acid solution, wearing splash goggles. No faces.
shots.narration: 倒消毒剂、配酸碱，都要戴。

shots.section_title: 有飞溅，戴防溅护目镜
shots.scene: 【实拍】戴上防溅护目镜，调整松紧带至贴合（正面中景，下半张脸不入镜）
shots.prompt_en: A person puts on chemical splash goggles and adjusts the strap until they seal around the eyes.
shots.narration: 调好松紧带，四周贴紧。

shots.section_title: 面屏加在护目镜外
shots.scene: 面屏护住整张脸和脖子
shots.prompt_en: A face shield covers the whole face and neck. No people.
shots.narration: 面屏护住整张脸和脖子。

shots.section_title: 面屏加在护目镜外
shots.scene: 面屏下面仍戴着护目镜
shots.prompt_en: A diagram shows goggles worn under a face shield. No people.
shots.narration: 面屏不能代替护目镜，要一起戴。

shots.section_title: 面屏加在护目镜外
shots.scene: 【实拍】先戴护目镜，再戴面屏并调好角度（正面中景，人物不露脸）
shots.prompt_en: A person in goggles lowers a face shield over them and adjusts its angle.
shots.narration: 先戴护目镜，再加面屏。

shots.section_title: 面屏加在护目镜外
shots.scene: 通风柜里倾倒浓酸，戴护目镜加面屏
shots.prompt_en: Inside a fume hood, gloved hands pour concentrated acid; the person wears goggles and a face shield. No faces.
shots.narration: 倒较多浓酸、可能剧烈反应时，加面屏。

shots.section_title: 普通眼镜不能代替护目镜
shots.scene: 普通眼镜四周空荡荡的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of ordinary glasses with open gaps around the edges. No people.
shots.narration: 普通眼镜，四周都是空的。
overlay: 普通眼镜不能代替护目镜

shots.section_title: 普通眼镜不能代替护目镜
shots.scene: 普通镜片碎裂，碎片飞向眼睛，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An ordinary lens shatters toward an eye icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 普通镜片不防碎，碎了更伤眼。

shots.section_title: 普通眼镜不能代替护目镜
shots.scene: 【实拍】把罩式护目镜戴在近视眼镜外面（侧面中景，人物不露全脸）
shots.prompt_en: A person wearing prescription glasses puts over-the-glasses goggles on top of them.
shots.narration: 近视的同学，护目镜罩在眼镜外。

shots.section_title: 普通眼镜不能代替护目镜
shots.scene: 过滤、加热、色谱三个实验图标，都配护目镜
shots.prompt_en: Three experiment icons, filtration, heating and chromatography, each paired with goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤、加热、色谱，全程都要戴。

shots.section_title: 化学实验室不戴隐形眼镜
shots.scene: 隐形眼镜盒被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A contact lens case crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 化学实验室，原则上不戴隐形眼镜。
overlay: 化学实验室不戴隐形眼镜

shots.section_title: 化学实验室不戴隐形眼镜
shots.scene: 溅入眼中的液体被困在隐形镜片后面的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a splashed liquid trapped behind a contact lens on an eye. No people.
shots.narration: 溅进眼里，镜片会挡住冲洗。

shots.section_title: 化学实验室不戴隐形眼镜
shots.scene: 框架眼镜加护目镜，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Prescription glasses with goggles over them, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 改戴框架眼镜，外罩护目镜。

shots.section_title: 看清标识，选合格产品
shots.scene: 护目镜镜框和镜片上的标识被放大镜放大
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over blank marking areas on a goggle frame and lens. No people.
shots.narration: 不能只看样子，看清镜框镜片标识。

shots.section_title: 看清标识，选合格产品
shots.scene: 合格包装和无标识包装对比，后者打叉
shots.prompt_en: A labeled goggle package with a quality mark next to an unmarked one crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 选符合国家标准、有合格标识的产品。

shots.section_title: 看清标识，选合格产品
shots.scene: 划花、开裂的护目镜放进报废盒
shots.prompt_en: Scratched and cracked goggles go into a disposal box. No people.
shots.narration: 镜片划花开裂，及时更换。

shots.section_title: 戴在眼睛上，全程不摘
shots.scene: 护目镜推在额头上，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Goggles pushed up on a forehead, crossed out with a red X. No real faces.
shots.narration: 护目镜要戴在眼睛上，不在额头上。

shots.section_title: 戴在眼睛上，全程不摘
shots.scene: 实验从开始到结束，时间轴上护目镜一直亮着
shots.prompt_en: A timeline from the start to the end of an experiment with a goggles icon glowing the whole time. No people.
shots.narration: 从进门到离开，全程戴着。

shots.section_title: 戴在眼睛上，全程不摘
shots.scene: 旁边同学在操作，自己也戴着
shots.prompt_en: One student works while a nearby student only watching also wears goggles.
shots.narration: 旁边有人操作，你也要戴。

shots.section_title: 各类实验的通用防护提醒
shots.scene: 实验服、护目镜、手套三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab coat, goggles and gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 各类实验，基本三件一样不少。
overlay: 各类实验的通用防护提醒

shots.section_title: 各类实验的通用防护提醒
shots.scene: 手套离火焰远一点
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand kept away from a burner flame. No faces.
shots.narration: 手套远离火焰，沾了溶剂就换。

shots.section_title: 各类实验的通用防护提醒
shots.scene: 手套拿样品，徒手打叉
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand holds a sample tube; a bare hand reaching for it is crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 不徒手拿样品，护己也护样品。

shots.section_title: 各类实验的通用防护提醒
shots.scene: 阿杰向王老师询问
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the safety administrator a question.
shots.narration: 穿戴什么，按评估，不清楚就问。

shots.section_title: 眼睛进了东西，立即冲洗
shots.scene: 眼睛溅入液体，立即走向洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: A person hurries to an eyewash station after a splash. No faces.
shots.narration: 眼睛溅入东西，马上去洗眼器。
overlay: 眼睛进了东西，立即冲洗

shots.section_title: 眼睛进了东西，立即冲洗
shots.scene: 洗眼器冲洗，撑开眼睑
shots.prompt_en: Water flows from an eyewash station while eyelids are held open. No faces.
shots.narration: 撑开眼睑，持续冲洗，别揉眼。

shots.section_title: 眼睛进了东西，立即冲洗
shots.scene: 报告实验室负责人并就医
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man and points toward a medical icon.
shots.narration: 报告负责人，及时就医。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 安全眼镜、护目镜、面屏依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: Safety spectacles, splash goggles and a face shield get green checks one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 防碎屑用眼镜，防飞溅用护目镜。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 护目镜加面屏，普通眼镜和隐形眼镜打叉
shots.prompt_en: Goggles with a face shield get a check; ordinary glasses alone and contact lenses get red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 面屏加在外面，普通眼镜不算。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣举起一副手套，挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a pair of gloves and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲防护手套的选择与使用。
